item.title: Animal Science Clinic
item.description: Washington County UI Extension is hosting its first Animal Science Clinic of 2026 on Feb. 21 from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. at the Washington County Fairgrounds. The clinic’s topic of Birth to Burger: The Livestock Life Cycle will give hands-on experience to 4-H and FFA members through a variety of topics at five stations. Date: Saturday, February 21, 2026 - 10:00am

item.title: WHS Proud Sound fundraiser dinner
item.description: The Weiser High School Proud Sound will have their annual fundraiser dinner on Feb. 28 from 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. at the Vendome Events Center. Tickets are $35 in advance, $40 at the door. Tickets may be purchased from a band or colorguard member or text/call Christy at 208-230-5419. Date: Saturday, February 28, 2026 - 5:00pm

item.title: Recognizing the team behind our water system
item.description: By: Herb Haun I would like to take a moment to recognize the dedicated men and women of the City of Weiser Water Department and to share a little about the work they do every day to keep our community supplied with safe, reliable drinking water. The City’s drinking water system can treat and deliver approximately 3.0 million gallons of water per day, with a current storage capacity of 3.5 million gallons. item.description: Dear Editor: I’ve written this letter to advise Washington County residents of a campaign that began in January 2025 and has continued into this year. item.title: A small cost, a big impact for everyone
item.description: Dear Editor: While we understand everyone can have their opinions, Mr. Schoenweis is casting aspersions without data to support his statements. It is unfortunate that anywhere in the country we would need a service such as the Safe Haven Baby Box, however, it is needed and not just in big cities.
